newsitem.title: MEXICO: Kimber sells Regio brand, other assets.
newsitem.headline: Kimber sells Regio brand, other assets.

text.p: Kimberly-Clark de Mexico (Kimber) said on Monday it agreed to sell its Regio tissue brand and 67,000 tonnes of production capacity to Mexican company Copamex.
The company said in a statement the deal was reached last Friday, and meets requirements set by the Federal Competition Commission when Kimber bought Crisoba last year.
Kimber was required by the government to sell off some of its assets so as not to hold a monopoly in the Mexican paper products market when it acquired Crisoba last year.
The company said the sale is subject to "certain conditions."
